adds.title: Court of Justice of Minas Gerais August 2026 Contagem shopping mall decision
adds.summary: In August 2026 the Court of Justice of Minas Gerais condemned a shopping mall in Contagem for constraining a trans woman.

adds.title: Supreme Federal Court decision (2019)
adds.summary: On 13 June 2019 Brazil's Supreme Federal Court voted eight to three to criminalize homophobia under Brazil's existing racism law until Congress enacts specific legislation, holding that sexual orientation and gender identity are essential to self-determination.
